title: See Beyond the Group Glow
description: When evaluating a group: - Pause and observe: "Am I judging individuals or the group as a whole?" - Focus on specifics: Look at individual contributions or qualities instead of the overall impression. - Compare individually: Evaluate members one by one to get a clearer picture. Example: Judging team performance? Break it down into individual efforts, not just the group’s vibe.
